answers.description: Answer a factual question using web search, optionally shaped into a flat JSON object of fields, with sources and citations. Suited to bounded, factual answers such as a company's founding year or a product's current price. Lists of items on a live page, such as the latest blog posts, come back more reliably from scraping that page.

batch_scrape_urls.description: Scrape a known list of URLs (up to 10,000) in one async job, for example URLs from a CSV or from search results. Returns a batch_id right away. `get_batch_results` returns the scraped content for that batch_id once the batch completes (about 5-8 min). Set `wait_for_completion_seconds` to wait for completion in the same call.

create_crawl.description: Crawl a website from a start URL: follows links on the same site and scrapes each page it finds, up to `max_pages`. Suited to getting many pages from one site, such as a docs section or a blog. Runs async and returns a crawl_id. `get_crawl_results` returns the crawl status and scraped pages for that crawl_id. Crawls and batches are separate resources, so a crawl_id works with `get_crawl_results`, not `get_batch_results`.

create_map.description: List the URLs on a website without scraping their content. Suited to showing a site's pages, mapping a site, or picking a subset of URLs to scrape. `create_crawl` both discovers and scrapes pages when their content is needed too.

get_batch_results.description: Retrieve the status and scraped content for a batch job. Pass the batch_id returned by batch_scrape_urls. If the batch is completed, returns the scraped content for each URL. If still in_progress, returns the current status so you can call again later.

get_crawl_results.description: Retrieve the status and scraped pages for a crawl job started with create_crawl. While the crawl is in_progress it returns the current status, so call again after about 10 seconds. Once completed, it returns the discovered pages with their scraped content in the requested formats.

get_webpage_content.description: Retrieve content of a webpage in markdown

get_website_urls.description: Find URLs on a website that match a search query, ranked by relevance. Returns links only and does not scrape page content.

scrape_website.description: Extract content from a single URL. Supports multiple formats and JavaScript rendering.

search_web.description: Search the web for a given query and return structured results (non-AI, parser-based).
